description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerLogAPI class, which implements CRUD API endpoints for managing performance tracker logs within an HR management system. It handles listing, creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting performance tracker logs, and includes OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for CRUD operations on performance tracker logs, including listing, creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting logs, with embedded OpenAPI documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all performance tracker logs for a specific tracker, including counts of positive and negative achievements.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new performance tracker log with provided details.

methods.name: setTrackerLogsParams
methods.description: Populates a PerformanceTrackerLog entity with data from request parameters.

methods.name: getCommonBodyParamRulesCollection
methods.description: Returns validation rules for common request body parameters used in create and update operations.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove logs associated with a specific tracker, validating access and IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single performance tracker log by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing performance tracker log with new data.
